jobs.title: Designer (Freelance, m/f/d)
jobs.description: Your mission About L1VE L1VE is a growing media and technology company with offices in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K/3D/360° streaming technology and innovative live formats, we are changing the way people experience sports, music and entertainment. Your Role As Designer, you shape how L1VE looks and how people experience it, from the first ad to the ticket purchase on our website. Our website is at the heart of the role: you design user journeys and pages that convert. You also create our event banners, flyers, ads and social assets. You take full ownership of design, build it up from the start and keep it lean, flexible and fast. You work closely with our Social Media Manager, our Content & Experience team and Product & Tech, and report to the Head of Marketing & Sales. Full-time (5 days/week), project-based, 12 months Work remotely within Europe or Asia, or on-site in Berlin What You'll Do Design and continuously improve our website, from first visit to ticket purchase, and make it instantly clear what L1VE is: a real live broadcast you experience with a VR headset Map and optimize user journeys; create wireframes, prototypes and final designs in Figma Design for conversion: identify drop-offs, develop hypotheses and test page and flow variants based on analytics data Hand over developer-ready, responsive designs and build a clear design system with reusable components Design landing pages, key visuals and asset packages for our live events (banners, flyers, posters, on-site materials) and for email campaigns Create paid ads for social and display (static and simple motion) in all required formats, with variations for A/B testing Follow the design guidelines of our license partners precisely, keep our brand consistent, and brief external freelancers or agencies when more capacity is needed Use AI tools for ideation, image creation, variations and resizing; L1VE provides the AI tools you need Your profile Must-have 3–5 years of experience as a designer with a focus on web/UX and marketing design, in-house or at an agency A portfolio with website and UX work with measurable conversion results, plus campaign and ad design Proven experience working precisely within strict brand and partner guidelines, e.g. from leagues, federations or licensors Strong UX skills and conversion experience: user journeys, wireframing, prototyping, landing pages, checkout or sign-up flows, A/B tests and working with analytics data Excellent command of Figma (components, design systems, developer handoff) and Adobe Creative Suite Strong sense of typography, layout and visual hierarchy, and a bold, creative eye Fluent written and spoken English (C1 or higher), German is a plus Nice-to-have Motion skills (After Effects or similar) Experience designing for paid social (Meta, TikTok), including formats and safe zones Experience preparing print production files Practical experience with AI design and image tools Interest in sports, entertainment and immersive technology Why us? You shape how L1VE looks and how users experience it, from the ground up, with real ownership. You see the direct impact of your work on conversion and ticket sales. You get access to the AI tools you need. You get plenty of creative freedom, short decision paths and flexible hours. Interested? Send us your CV, a link to your portfolio, your day rate, and a few sentences on why you're a great fit for L1VE and the Designer role. L1VE is committed to equal opportunities. We welcome applications regardless of origin, gender, age, religion, disability or sexual identity. Contact person Annette Hansen - Recruiting Manager Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest strategische Projekte im Bereich Baubarkeit von der ersten Analyse bis zur Umsetzung. Du analysierst unseren Sales- und Operations-Funnel und identifizierst, an welchen Stellen und aus welchen Gründen wir bei Kund:innen nicht bauen können. Du bewertest den Impact unterschiedlicher Initiativen, erstellst Business Cases und leitest daraus Prioritäten ab. Du identifizierst innovative Bautechnologien und Prozesse im Bereich erneuerbarer Energien und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team in die Umsetzung. Du steuerst die Realisierung mit Operations, Technik, Software und externen Partnern, bis die Lösung im Tagesgeschäft funktioniert. Du bewegst dich an der Schnittstelle von Prozessen, technischen Fragestellungen und Softwarethemen und bringst die richtigen Beteiligten zusammen. Du bist Teil eines kleinen, agilen Teams, übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und siehst unmittelbar, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Dein Profil Du studierst, befindest dich im Gap Year oder hast dein Studium kürzlich abgeschlossen, wobei die Fachrichtung zweitrangig ist. Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung gesammelt, idealerweise in einem Startup oder Scale-up, einer Beratung oder im Banking. Du bist umsetzungsstark, packst Themen an und bringst sie zum Abschluss. Du gehst strukturiert vor, denkst in Prozessen und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten parallel den Überblick. Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, auch wenn sie technisch werden. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch und kommunizierst klar und überzeugend mit Stakeholdern aus unterschiedlichsten Bereichen. Du möchtest nah am Geschehen sein und echten Impact haben und hast Lust, 3 bis 6 Monate mit dem Team vor Ort in Berlin zu arbeiten. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Release Engineering
jobs.description: Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture. About Superhuman Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here . The Opportunity We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Developer Experience/Release Engineering team in Berlin. You will own how code travels from a developer’s commit to millions of users across Superhuman’s products: Grammarly, Superhuman Docs, and Superhuman Mail. As our product suite grows, so do the number of engineers contributing to it and the number of surfaces we release on (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions, APIs). Our team makes shipping fast, safe, and boring. The team builds and runs the CI/CD platform, release pipelines, and rollout tooling that let product teams deploy many times a day with confidence; it enables engineers to be productive, use new technologies to optimize the SLDC, and push on green many times a day. You will lead a team of engineers working at the intersection of developer productivity, infrastructure, and reliability. You will partner with Product Engineering, SRE, Platform/Infrastructure, and Security to increase release speed and safety. This role is hands-on: you will help set the technical direction and stay close to the work. As an Engineering Manager, Release Engineering, you will: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Engineers; hire great people and build a strong, inclusive team culture in Berlin and across a distributed organization. Own the strategy and roadmap for CI/CD, build, and release systems that scale with company growth and the number of products and surfaces we ship. Drive faster, safer delivery: improve lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and time to restore, and make these measures visible to engineering leadership. Build and operate release tooling, including progressive rollouts, canaries, feature flags, automated rollback, and release health monitoring. Coordinate release trains and launches across all our products, working with Product, QA, Support, and Marketing to ensure major launches land smoothly. Partner with SRE, Infrastructure, and Security to keep the delivery platform reliable and compliant, including supply chain security, artifact integrity, and access controls. Reduce friction for product engineers: cut build and test times, eliminate flaky tests and pipelines, and offer self-service paths so teams can ship without waiting on us. Act as an escalation point and Incident Commander for release-related incidents, and lead blameless postmortems that turn into lasting fixes. Balance near-term pipeline fixes with foundational investments, and make clear tradeoffs in a fast-moving environment. Stay hands-on where it matters: review designs, help debug tough pipeline problems, and set a high engineering bar. Qualifications Have 5+ years of software, DevOps, or release/build engineering experience, and 2+ years managing engineers (or engineering managers) with a record of hiring, developing, and retaining talent. Bring hands-on depth in CI/CD systems and build tooling (for example, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite, Bazel, or similar) and can reason independently about pipeline archite

jobs.title: GRC Automation Analyst
jobs.description: Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture. About Superhuman Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com . The Opportunity We’ve consolidated separate compliance programs (Grammarly, Coda, Superhuman Mail, and Superhuman Go) into a single program. We’re rapidly replacing the point-in-time approaches with continuous, automated, code-defined evidence, and this role continues to build on that. The job is to automate your way out of the manual toil: our GRC automation platform is the evidence-automation backbone, agentic systems (Claude Code and similar) are the force multiplier, and GitHub is where the program lives as code. If your instinct on seeing a manual control-testing process is to turn it into a repeatable, automated pipeline, this role is for you. What You Will Do: Automate evidence collection. Configure and operate the GRC automation platform: wire up data sources, build evidence plugins, scope data sets, author analysis rules, and stand up continuous monitoring operations, replacing screenshot-and-upload workflows with automated collectors mapped to controls. Automate GRC workflows and run compliance as code. Use Claude Code (or similar) and MCPs for evidence requests, control mapping, gap analysis, vendor reviews, and reporting; build and curate the team’s agent harness; and manage policies, control definitions, and automation in GitHub through branches, pull requests, and review. Design control testing and drive remediation. Instrument testing across SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, and ISO 42001 for continuous assurance rather than point-in-time snapshots, and work with control owners and engineering to close gaps with automated evidence behind every finding. What Ramping Up Looks Like: You will be configuring our GRC automation platform, not just clicking through it, within your first few weeks. In your first 90 days, we’d expect you to learn the platform configuration, ship your first automated evidence collectors, retire a batch of manual screenshot evidence, and get at least one agent-assisted workflow running end-to-end. Why This Role: You’ll design the automation architecture for compliance across four products, rather than maintaining an existing checklist. You get the mandate and the tooling to retire manual evidence collection: a GRC automation platform, agentic AI, and compliance-as-code. We actually run LLMs and AI agents in production GRC workflows today. This is how the team operates day-to-day. Small team, high ownership, and a direct line to Legal and Engineering leadership. You’ll shape the program, not just sustain it. Qualifications 5+ years in compliance, GRC, or IT audit, hands-on with the frameworks above (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and adjacent). 1+ year using agentic AI systems (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to do real compliance work, with automation you have delivered, not just prototypes. Comfortable in GitHub: repos, branches, pull requests, and code review. CI/CD familiarity is a strong plus. Fast on new tooling. You can pick up a GRC automation platform and be productive in weeks, configuring it directly rather than relying on others

jobs.title: Product Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix. At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires. I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves. Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week. That means a top-notch engineer who leads from the codebase. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You'll ship every week and lead the team's biggest technical work — and as the team grows, you'll grow into managing it. You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win. — Grigory Why Secfix exists Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it. Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. jobs.title: Senior Sales Recruiter
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role: Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels. Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.  And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we're looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense. The Challenge: Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter. The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process. Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success. In this role, you will: Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands. Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel. Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker. Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region. Strong Backgrounds successful in this role: The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace. In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - SAP & ERP Specialist
jobs.description: TL;DR You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. At Conduct you turn that into a game changing moment: you show leadership, with confidence, how Conduct will transform the way they run SAP. You own optimising the delivery of transformation projects with Conduct, from the first use case to adoption across the business. You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next. Why Conduct The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand. Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service. We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out. What you'll own You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product. Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast. Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there. Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account. Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap. Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly. Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes. No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team. Who we hire We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with. jobs.description: About Us: Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Track program data: log knowledge-base gaps, recurring questions we can't answer well yet, and where automation is saving or costing time, and share findings with the team. Cross-functional influence: work more closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Sales to make our security and AI-safety posture a differentiator rather than a checkbox. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Guardian
jobs.description: About the Team The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm. Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products. Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group. About the Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Guardian team in London. You will design and build production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users. This is a hands-on engineering role with substantial technical depth and ownership. You will work across architecture, implementation, evaluation, and operations, taking projects from early exploration through production deployment. The work requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound product judgment, and comfort solving problems where both the requirements and the underlying technology are evolving. You will work closely with alignment researchers to translate emerging research into dependable systems, and with product and engineering teams to make agent safety a foundational capability across OpenAI. This role is based in our London office. In this role, you will: Design, build, and operate core components of Auto-review and the broader Guardian platform, balancing safety, product utility, latency, and operational reliability. Build production systems that evaluate agent actions in real time, detect potentially harmful behavior, and support safe recovery or escalation paths. Improve how oversight systems understand user intent, environmental context, permissions, and relevant personalization signals while protecting privacy and avoiding unnecessary friction. Partner closely with alignment researchers to turn prototypes, evaluations, and new monitoring techniques into scalable product capabilities. Work across Product, Security, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to integrate Guardian capabilities into agent experiences throughout OpenAI. Develop evaluations, adversarial tests, and monitoring to understand safety performance, false positives, latency, and user impact. Own projects end to end, contribute to technical direction and design reviews, and investigate failures to improve system behavior and reliability. You might thrive in this role if you: Have experience building and shipping complex production software, with ownership across design, implementation, deployment, and operation. Have built with AI agents or large language models in a core product, startup, or technically serious independent project, and understand the unique challenges of agentic systems. Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and can design reliable backend services, APIs, and infrastructure. Exercise sound product-engineering judgment and can navigate tradeoffs across safety, usability, speed, and reliability. Enjoy working closely with researchers, translating open-ended ideas into practical systems, and using experiments and evaluations to guide decisions. Are comfortable with ambiguity, take initiative, and communicate clearly across technical disciplines. Care deeply about building AI systems that are useful, trustworthy, and safe. jobs.description: Localisation : Paris Type de contrat : CDI L’entreprise Pysae édite la solution de gestion d'exploitation des réseaux de transport public : géolocalisation temps réel des véhicules, information voyageurs, pilotage des opérations. Un rôle clé dans la croissance d’une startup SaaS à impact positif : chaque client fidélisé, c’est un réseau de transport plus fiable pour ses voyageurs, au quotidien. jobs.description: About Pysae Pysae is a French SaaS company building real-time fleet supervision (AVM / SAEIV) and workforce management software for public transport operators. Bus networks, coach operators and transport authorities in France and across Europe rely on our platform every day to run their services, inform passengers and manage their drivers. We are a team of around 40 people based in Rennes, Paris and Italy, and we are expanding fast internationally. Pysae has grown from a set of products into a full platform. We now need someone to tell that story, put it in front of the right people, and turn it into growth. The role Reporting to our Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will own product marketing and growth: generating demand through the product itself and by showcasing the value of the Pysae platform. This is an international role. You will work on France, Italy and our new markets across Europe and beyond, with sales teams and customers in several countries and languages. This is not a classic marketing job. Our market (public transport operators and authorities) has long been sold to in the same way: tenders, trade shows and long sales cycles. We want to break that pattern. Your mission is to invent, test and deploy new ways of selling and growing , using the product, content, data and AI as levers. You will have a blank page, direct access to the CRO and the founders, and the freedom to try things that have never been done in our industry. It is a very exciting position, and a demanding one: you will need to come up with ideas, prove quickly whether they work, drop what doesn't and scale what does. jobs.title: People & Admin Ops.
jobs.description: 🩺 Why Prévenir Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in the Île-de-France region. Our ambition is to rethink occupational health in order to improve its impact on employees’ lives and the experience of healthcare professionals, leveraging Alan’s technology. Our first medical centre has opened at 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris, and this is just the beginning! 👉 To learn more about what day-to-day life is like at Prévenir, click here . ⭐ The role, concretely Are you excited about building, structuring and scaling HR operations in a company that's just getting started? You will join Prévenir at a very early stage and help build the foundations of our People and administrative operations as the company scales. This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey. We're in the early chapters: this isn't about running existing processes — it's about creating them from scratch so they hold up at much larger scale. The role brings a product mindset to People operations, where every key moment of the employee experience is carefully designed, with a constant focus on simplicity and automation. You'll work closely with Lucie, who makes the final calls depending on topic complexity and supports you as you grow into autonomy. Your time is split between: Employee journey: onboarding, probation-period tracking, setting up and running performance reviews, feedback processes, and monitoring team engagement. Documentation & operational efficiency: writing clear, user-centric documentation, spotting friction, simplifying or automating recurring processes. You leverage AI to multiply the impact of your work. People admin: leave and absence management, payroll back-and-forth, contracting and employee administrative follow-up, onboarding formalities and affiliations (health/provident insurance, occupational health), GDPR compliance. Operational finance: expense reports, preparing and sending accounting documents to Impulsa, preparing routine filings (including VAT). Over time, this person will take ownership of payroll management in coordination with our accounting partner, with training and support. 👤 The profile we're looking for Essential: At least 5-6 years of experience in People Ops, very hands-on, and comfortable with admin topics (e.g., managing the relationship with an accounting firm) Previous experience in a fast-scaling company, start-up or scale-up, ideally having helped build or scale People processes during a period of significant growth. Business curiosity: genuinely interested in what's happening on the business side, and able to connect your work to where the company is heading Versatility across People and Corporate/Admin topics, with a strong People focus Rigour and rock-solid attention to detail Autonomy: you don't wait to be told there's a problem — you spot it, bring a solution, and know when to loop someone in on the tricky ones Demonstrated interest in automating and improving recurring processes, and genuine enthusiasm for AI Comfort interacting with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior profiles when needed Fluent English (written and spoken) to interact with the Alan team Based in Paris or the Île-de-France region, with the ability to work onsite regularly, ideally three days per week or more. Ideally: Experience in MedTech or in a start-up / scale-up Sensitivity to the medical world (professional or personal) Note: a 100% Occupational Health background may not be the right cultural fit, but worth testing 🙏 What we offer Location : 117 Quai de Valmy, Paris 10th, in a brand-new centre designed to support high-quality practice Base salary : between €53,000 and €61,000 gross per year , depending on experience and level Profit-sharing scheme : 10% , in line with Prévenir’s framework Benefits : daily transport costs covered, company restaurant, RTT days and regular team events

jobs.title: Quantum Dot Process & Characterisation Engineer- Post-Growth Processing (Master)
jobs.description: Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.  Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 Role overview We are looking for a Process & Characterisation Engineer to prepare and validate GaAs/AlGaAs samples containing InAs quantum dots (QDs) through the first steps of our single-photon source fabrication flow. The role combines hands-on cleanroom processing – chemical treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing – with optical characterisation of the QDs before and after each step. The data you produce decides whether a sample is ready to move forward, and how the process recipes should be adjusted. You will start by running an established, well-documented procedure with rigour and consistency. As you build expertise, the role is designed to grow: within your first year, you will contribute to optimising the process, automating the measurement setups and taking ownership of sample validation for these steps, working closely with both the Production and R&D teams. Sample preparation & processing (from day one) Run the established step-by-step procedure for preparing GaAs/AlGaAs samples with InAs quantum dots. Carry out the cleanroom fabrication steps: chemical surface treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing. Follow recipes and operating procedures precisely, and flag any deviation, drift or anomaly as soon as it appears. Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. Optical characterisation & validation Measure QD optical properties before and after processing, using photoluminescence and white-field imaging, including at cryogenic temperature. Compare pre- and post-processing results against acceptance criteria to decide whether each sample can be released to the next fabrication steps. Adjust process recipes based on measurement results, within defined process windows. Data, reporting & traceability Analyse measurement data using Python and report results clearly and regularly to the Production and R&D teams. Maintain the sample database so that every sample’s processing history and measurements are fully traceable. Keep process documentation and procedures up to date. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis. Responsibilities Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds. Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production. Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times. Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early. Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations. Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers. Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria. Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering. Requirements You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units. You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection. You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts. You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline. You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers. You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar. You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. jobs.title: Sales Manager CH, KI-Software für Psychotherapeut:innen
jobs.description: Über VIA HealthTech VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat. Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat. Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf. Die Rolle Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus. In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem. Deine Aufgaben Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen. Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen. Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt. Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Was konvertiert, welche Einwände in der Schweiz wirklich kommen (etwa zu Datenschutz und Datenhaltung), welche Sequenz funktioniert. Zahlen verantworten. Deine KPIs entlang des Funnels, gemeinsam mit unserem Commercial Engine Lead, der Tracking und Infrastruktur baut. Sales-Enablement-Material. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF. Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam. Dein Profil Must-have Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Entweder bringst du diesen Hintergrund mit, oder du arbeitest dich so schnell und so tief ein, dass man es dir im Gespräch nicht anmerkt Systemdenken. Du baust reproduzierbare Prozesse statt Einzelfälle, mit dem Ziel, dass dein Ansatz auch ohne dich funktioniert Hunger und unternehmerischer Ehrgeiz. Du willst einen neuen Markt aufbauen, nicht eine Quote abarbeiten Kommunikationsstärke mit Abschlussfokus. Empathisch und auf Augenhöhe, denn Psychotherapeut:innen merken sofort, wenn jemand verkauft, statt zu verstehen Selbstständige, strukturierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, auch remote und ohne Team vor Ort, sowie sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Syste

We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job. We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow. We are committed to changing the way things are done. Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position  Work from anywhere! You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it. jobs.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready. This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate . Key responsibilities Certification strategy and project management Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine) Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) Safety engineering and risk analysis Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882) Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports Compliance and technical documentation Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates Collaboration and continuous improvement Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations). Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical) Standards and regulatory scope The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Required qualifications Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine) Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110 Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard Solid know

jobs.title: Ontwikkelaar vastgoed
jobs.description: Wil jij bouwen aan de vastgoedopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als ervaren ontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na acquisitie en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting verkoop en realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met adviseurs én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.   Dit wordt jouw baan Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na acquisitie / tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de het ontwikkelteam om projecten succesvol verder te brengen.   Wat ga je doen De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen of een acquisitie is verworven en projecten daadwerkelijk ontwikkeld gaan worden. Je werkt aan (middel)grote vastgoedontwikkelingen en ben je de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het uitwerken van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. ·       Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning/acquisitie, naar omgevingsvergunning tot aan de start van de verkoop; ·       Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces; ·       Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering; ·       Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's; ·       Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders; ·       Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken; ·       Je werkt nauw samen met makelaars, verkoopmanagers en notarissen om projecten succesvol in verkoop te brengen; ·       Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming; ·       Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op jouw plek Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoo

jobs.title: Stage communicatie bouwplaatsprotocol
jobs.description: Stage communicatie bouwplaatsprotocol Locatie: Haaften | 32–40 uur | Start: februari, maar mag ook per direct! Wat jij tijdens je stage maakt wordt straks écht gebruikt op onze bouwplaatsen Hoe ziet een goed ingerichte bouwplaats eruit? Waar hoort de bewegwijzering? Welke uitstraling geven we bouwhekdoeken? Hoe maken we duidelijk wat de standaard is voor veiligheid, afval, parkeren of bezoekers? En vooral: hoe zorg je dat een uitvoerder niet eindeloos hoeft te zoeken, maar in één oogopslag weet wat nodig is en welk materieel daarbij hoort? Dat willen we bij Dura Vermeer vastleggen in één Bouwplaatsprotocol : een praktische handleiding én visuele standaard voor de bouwplaats. Het laat zien hoe we onze bouwplaatsen herkenbaar, netjes, veilig en slim inrichten. En dat protocol ga jij helpen maken. Dit maakt deze stage interessant: Je zit tijdens deze stage precies tussen communicatie, ontwerp en de praktijk van de bouw in. De ene dag praat je met een uitvoerder over wat er wel en niet werkt. jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. jobs.title: Model Risk Officer
jobs.description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle. What you'll ship Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each. Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models. Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers. Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks. Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit. What you'll bring Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models. Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced. Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook. Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them. The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own ter

jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! What you’ll be doing: Tool Operation & Processing: Safely and accurately operate cleanroom production equipment. Process Execution: Strictly follow established recipes, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and safety guidelines to ensure consistent wafer-scale fabrication. Quality & Monitoring: Monitor tool performance during production runs. Perform basic inspections of the wafers and immediately flag any anomalies, defects, or machine errors to the engineering team. Accurate Documentation: Log production data, batch records, and tool usage clearly and accurately to maintain full traceability of our products. Cleanroom Maintenance: Help maintain a pristine working environment, ensuring workstations are prepped, materials are stocked, and cleanroom protocols are strictly followed. Your profile You bring practical experience from a high-precision manufacturing environment and possess the discipline to work independently in an academic cleanroom environment. Excellent communication skills, able to collaborate effectively across R&D and production teams. Organized & detail-oriented, able to document your work clearly and follow established procedures. You are a clear communicator who works well in a team and knows when to escalate issues to the engineers. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! As our portfolio grows in scale and complexity, we are looking to further strengthen our investment capabilities, combining strategic thinking, commercial insight and disciplined decision-making to accelerate value creation across the business. To support this next stage of growth, we are seeking a Chief Investment Officer. Reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with the Executive Committee, Board and shareholders, the CIO will play a central role in shaping the future direction of SkyNRG. This role combines the analytical rigor of an investment professional with the strategic perspective of a business leader. It offers the opportunity to influence some of the most significant decisions facing the company while contributing directly to the development of projects and partnerships that support the future of sustainable aviation. Support the development of bankable, financeable and commercially attractive SAF projects. Lead selected M&A, partnership and corporate development opportunities that contribute to SkyNRG's long-term growth strategy. Act as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Executive Committee, Board and shareholders on investment strategy, capital allocation and portfolio prioritization. You will oversee investment evaluations, valuation methodologies, business case development and portfolio prioritization to support informed decision-making at Executive Committee and Board level. Portfolio Development You will help maximize value across SkyNRG's portfolio by strengthening investment discipline throughout the project lifecycle. jobs.title: Mandatory Internship Overall Aircraft Design (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: Be part of aviation history at VÆRIDION, where we’re pioneering the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft! As an Overall Aircraft Design Intern (all genders) , you will join our Central Engineering team and support across various Overall Aircraft Design activities. This role is a broad role, and you will perform different tasks to support on-going aircraft design and analysis activities. You will be part of our interdisciplinary aircraft design team and contribute directly to the design process of our battery-electric aircraft. Your Day-to-Day: Support the analysis and comparison of battery-electric aircraft concepts across different configurations and mission profiles. Investigate how technology assumptions and key design parameters influence aircraft performance, energy demand, and overall feasibility. Develop and adapt computational tools to support aircraft sizing, mission analysis, and design trade-off studies. Perform parameter and sensitivity studies to explore design dependencies and identify key technology drivers. Collect, assess, and organise technical data to support consistent modelling assumptions and comparative analyses. Document methods, assumptions, and results, and prepare clear visualisations to discuss findings with the engineering team. Your Profile: Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree programme in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical discipline. Holding a Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical discipline. Excellent programming skills (e.g., Python, MATLAB). Experience with aircraft design process, methods and tools. Experience with dedicated tools such as OpenMDAO and Aviary is a strong plus. Readily available knowledge about aircraft. Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset, combined with a strong motivation for aviation and electric aircraft technologies. We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. Why us? Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation. We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments. Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us. Become a part of our success with virtual stock options. Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket. Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability. Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security. Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work close to the innovative Aerospace TU Delft. Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects. Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports). VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
jobs.description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. THE ROLE At Flock, we’re transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team! WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: You’ll have the autonomy to manage and develop a large business portfolio, mentor junior team members, and significantly contribute to team targets. You’ll help unlock growth into new market segments, offering insurance solutions for emerging mobility trends, and support our ambition to become one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. Your expertise will drive growth and innovation, positioning us at the forefront of the fleet insurance industry. You’ll also work with AI in the underwriting process itself, using it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, which leaves your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation)
jobs.description: Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation) The Role You’ll own the quality of the Lyrebird platform, from the first commit to the release gate. This is a hands-on, code-first engineering role, not manual test scripting. You’ll make our Playwright end-to-end and integration suites faster and more reliable, build contract tests that stop backend changes from silently breaking the web app, and design ways to evaluate clinical model output where exact-match assertions don’t work. You’ll also be the quality partner to our SRE function, giving them the health checks, synthetic monitors, load test results and post-deployment signals they need. When a release is ready to go, you’ll give a clear yes or no, backed by evidence. This role suits an engineer who sees testing as a craft and treats a test suite as production code. You’re comfortable moving between TypeScript and Python in the same day, you get real satisfaction from deleting a flaky test and cutting minutes off a pipeline, and you’d rather help other engineers write better tests than be the only person who writes them. You’ll enjoy the hard problem at the centre of this role: how to prove that non-deterministic AI output is safe and accurate enough for clinicians to rely on. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. What you’ll do Optimise our Playwright end-to-end suite, cutting run time and removing flaky tests for good Extend our API and partner integration suites, and build contract tests from our OpenAPI schemas so no backend change can break the web app without warning Add coverage gates to our Buildkite pipeline, using reporting that already breaks quality down by product area Support and collaborate with our engineering teams with CICD development and oversight Test the clinical output of our models with DeepEval, openevals and Langfuse traces, designing evaluations that hold up when responses change from run to run Run load tests with Locust ahead of major releases and hand clear findings to the SRE function Build the signals SRE depends on: health checks, synthetic monitors and post-deployment tests Own the release quality gate, giving a clear yes or no with the evidence behind it Raise the standard of testing across engineering through shared patterns, fixtures and At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment.&nbsp; As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.</p> <p>This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product.&nbsp; AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. &nbsp; Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.</p> <p>This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.</p> <h4><strong>You should apply if:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span></h4> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world:</strong> Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work:</strong> One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Who are we At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel. By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost. Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control. Location While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain. This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.   About the Team We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a cross-functional team in our Product Engineering organization. Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, find out what they need, set their own goals and choose how to solve the problems that matter most. AI is already part of how we build software at Lokalise, and it's changing what great engineering leadership looks like. We're looking for a leader who stays close to the work and understands how AI is changing speed, quality and engineers' day-to-day experience. You'll keep your teams focused on outcomes that matter to our customers and our business, not just on how much gets shipped. For this role, you'll lead our Editing Experience team. The team owns the tools linguists and reviewers use every day to translate, review and approve content at scale: the translation editor, the review and approval workflow, content management tools and the developer utilities that support them. Together with your Product Manager and Designer, you'll own the team's strategy and delivery end to end.   What You Will Do Lead, coach and develop your teams of Software Engineers. You'll support their career growth, run performance evaluations, contribute to compensation planning and hire engineers who raise the bar. Stay technically close to the work without becoming a bottleneck. You'll review key designs and pull requests, pair with engineers on tricky problems and take on contributions outside the critical path (such as tooling, prototypes or small fixes). This keeps you in touch with the codebase and your teams' daily reality while they own delivery. Partner with Product Managers and Designers (the Product Triad) to understand our customers deeply and take part in discovery. You'll make sure your teams work on the right problems, putting outcomes ahead of outputs. Connect engineering decisions to business impact. Understand how your domain contributes to customer value, retention and revenue, and use that to guide trade-offs on scope, investment and technical debt. Own your teams' flow of work from start to finish. Track and act on delivery and quality signals (such as cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate and recovery time), clear bottlenecks across planning, review, testing and release, and keep cognitive load sustainable. Lead your teams' move to AI-native engineering across the SDLC. Embed AI tools and agentic workflows, measure their real effect on speed, quality and how engineers experience their work, and adapt team practices so faster delivery never costs reliability or maintainability. Champion operational excellence. Drive reliability and quality practices, own the health of the ser

jobs.title: Senior Bazel Engineer
jobs.description: About us Tweag is a software consultancy that helps engineering organizations overcome technical bottlenecks that stand in the way of success. Our work in scalable build systems, primarily through Bazel, helps our clients grow their tech organization without the maintenance burden. About you Tweag works with organizations at all experience levels, from trying out Bazel for the first time, to refactoring and scaling Bazel workspaces with hundreds of thousands of potential targets. In every situation, we are the experts, helping them achieve their goals and delighting them with improvements they never expected. We are looking for someone who can handle: Integration with as-yet-unsupported languages. Development of specialized Bazel toolchains. Improving open-source Bazel rules to unblock our clients. Using Gazelle to standardize and clean up code. Refactoring Bazel code, and teaching others how to do so. Debugging the internals of Bazel. In addition, we'd appreciate Ties to the Bazel community. Active maintenance of Bazel open-source tools. Expertise in Bazel performance optimization, both within rules and in evaluating the build graph. Knowledge of other reproducible build systems, such as Nix, Buck2, or Pants. You'll love Tweag if you love A fully remote workplace with strong respect for work-life balance. Working on complex engineering problems, often with no right answer. A research-informed culture, with plenty of nerding out about computer science and mathematics.
